name: Pacific Aerospace 750XL
summary: New Zealand-built single turboprop utility plane with a boxy fuselage and a big rear door, popular as a skydiving aircraft.

engines: Single PT6A turboprop in the nose
fuselage: Large rear door for cargo or skydivers
tail: Tall swept fin with a dorsal fillet

tellTales: Boxy high-wing single turboprop with a big, flat-sided fuselage
Large door in the rear fuselage, common on skydiving aircraft
Fixed tricycle gear and a single strut per side

confusedWith.howToTell: The Caravan has a rounder, tapered body and often a belly cargo pod; the 750XL is a boxier, slab-sided aircraft with no pod.
The Porter has a tailwheel and a long pointed nose with an exhaust; the 750XL has tricycle gear and a short, deep nose.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
